title: Show me the City! A Small Group Walking Tour of Toronto
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by an adult
If you are travelling by car into Toronto, please be aware that Toronto is the 3rd worst city for traffic congestion. Please plan for a long drive (especially on weekdays).
This tour will not operate if there is severe weather in the forecast for the time of the tour, OR, if the temperature is above 34C/95F or below -18C/OF
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Show Me the City is rated one of the top 10 rated walking tours in North America. 

Operated by Buzz Tours, this award-winning downtown Toronto walking tour has earned a 4.9+ star rating for a decade, earning thousands of five-star reviews on TripAdvisor, Google, Viator, and Airbnb Experiences. 

Our guides have lived in the city for years and have also been leading our tours for years. Our guides are professionals who combine history, storytelling, humour and insider tips which enhance your walking experience.

As we walk along the streets, you will see some of Toronto’s most iconic landmarks — including the CN Tower, Union Station, Harbourfront, Old Town Toronto, PATH (Toronto’s Underground City), the Flatiron Building and the St. Lawrence Market. 

If you’re looking for the top-rated walking tour in Toronto, the Show Me the City is the Walking Tour that delivers the most complete and enjoyable introduction to the city.

We look forward to seeing you on one of our tours.
